primary: Four original released prompts, unchanged: grid/channel/action semantics, named tensors, all 17,253 rounded weights directly in prompt. One fresh session, one response, no tools. Same neutral system instruction and effort label as authors.
control: One shared shape/layout-only prompt, because all four architectures/layouts are identical. This is a prior diagnostic, not four independent shape predictions.
scoring: Use Game: line, same original keyword mapping. Road-crossing Frogger counts as Freeway. Confidence and numerical observations reported separately. Freeze outputs before scoring.
interpretation: Cross-model reproduction of released inputs, not a rerun of training or an equal-compute comparison. One selected checkpoint/run per game.
